idea: a slow folk song about walking home by lantern light
title: Lantern Road
lyrics:
[Verse]
Lantern swinging, gravel road
Every window gold
I count the gates I used to climb
Before the night got cold
[Chorus]
Carry me home, carry me home
The long way round the hill
[Verse]
The river keeps its own slow time
The mill wheel standing still
[Chorus]
Carry me home, carry me home
The long way round the hill
[Outro]
Lantern low, the gate swings wide

caption.global_metadata: Slow acoustic folk, 72 BPM, D major, warm and close, a quiet build into the last chorus.
caption.vocal_details: Soft male lead with a low harmony in the chorus, breathy on the verses.
caption.arrangement: Verse: fingerpicked guitar and room tone. Chorus: brushed drums and upright bass. Outro: guitar alone, slowing.
